Definition: Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine
KeyPassages: 1 Samuel 4:1; 1 Samuel 29:1; 1 Kings 20:26; 2 Kings 13:17; Joshua 12:18; Judges 1:31
BiblicalUsage: Aphek is the name of three places, and the Bible keeps returning to it: Israel camped at Aphek before the ark was taken, the Philistines gathered there before Gilboa, Ben-Hadad's army was routed there, and the arrow Elisha told Joash to shoot was aimed toward it. One name, three towns, and a long history of battles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Aphek matters because battles were fought there again and again: the ground where God's people lost the ark is also the ground where God gave them victory, and I hold that no place is lost to him for good.
